Encrypts the sign-in signing keys. Derived from CYBEDEFEND_SECRET_KEY (HKDF, base64) by the init-secrets job; read from <KEY>_FILE.
invite_only (default): an administrator invites each user; open: anyone who reaches the sign-up page.

Which job a one-shot cron process runs; set per job by the scheduler (runtime/schedules/*.json).
The gateway the MCP tools call with the caller's bearer: http://gateway:3000.
community in every container. Must be a real environment variable of the container: a value written only in a service .env file is ignored.

true accepts a kubeconfig that does not verify the cluster's API server (insecure-skip-tls-verify: true, or an http:// server), with a warning at every start. For a test cluster only; unset, such a kubeconfig is refused.
Name of a Secret in the scan namespace that the scanner pods pull their images with; unset, the pods pull without credentials.
Registry and path the scanner images (cybedefend-scanners/<adapter>) are pulled from, for a mirror; unset, the public CybeDefend registry.
Tag of the scanner images; unset, the version this release is compatible with.
true keeps each finished scanner pod and its Secret in the cluster for debugging, until the scan's data is deleted.
Path, inside security-scanning, of a mounted kubeconfig file for the cluster that runs the scans; set with CYBEDEFEND_SCANNER_NAMESPACE, or neither for import-only.
How many scans run on the cluster at once (1 to 50); the others wait in the queue.
Kubernetes namespace the scanner pods and their Secrets are created in; set with CYBEDEFEND_SCANNER_KUBECONFIG_FILE, or neither for import-only.
JSON that overrides the CPU and memory requests and limits of a scanner's pods, per adapter (opengrep, zizmor, gitleaks, trivy-config, trivy-fs).

OCI repository of your mirror of Trivy's vulnerability database (host[:port]/path[:tag], several separated by commas), handed to the SCA scanner pod (trivy-fs) as TRIVY_DB_REPOSITORY; unset, Trivy downloads its public database.

OCI repository of your mirror of Trivy's Java database, handed to the SCA scanner pod (trivy-fs) as TRIVY_JAVA_DB_REPOSITORY; unset, Trivy downloads its public database when the project holds Java archives.

Master key of the instance (at least 32 random bytes, base64 or hex). Every encryption key is derived from it: never change it, back it up. The compose file mounts it, from the file secret-key (CYBEDEFEND_SECRET_KEY_PATH), into the init-secrets job only, as a secret (CYBEDEFEND_SECRET_KEY_FILE); that job hands each service the derived keys it reads as <KEY>_FILE. The variable itself, in .env, is the earlier way, still read with a warning.
One-time token the first-run setup page asks for before it creates the first administrator (at least 16 characters).

The TLS proxies in front of the web interface and the MCP server (passed to it as TRUST_PROXY_CIDR) (comma-separated IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDRs, empty by default). The front's nginx trusts the X-Forwarded-For they append and hands the gateway that single client address; without it every user behind a proxy shares the proxy's address in the per-address rate limits. An invalid value stops the dashboard container at start.
The service database on the single PostgreSQL, created by postgres/init.sql.
postgres, the single PostgreSQL 18 of the stack.
Password of the service's own role, read from DB_PASSWORD_FILE (derived from CYBEDEFEND_SECRET_KEY by the init-secrets job; never the superuser's password, derived as well).
Read only when DB_SSL_ENABLED=true; the bundled PostgreSQL is reached without TLS.
Read only when DB_SSL_ENABLED=true.
Read only when DB_SSL_ENABLED=true.
false: the bundled PostgreSQL is reached on the internal network only.
postgres. The Community Edition refuses mysql (and the default, mysql) with DB_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED.
The service's own role, named after its database and owner of that database only (set up by the postgres-roles job).
Upload limit of a diff scan: number of files.
Upload limit of a diff scan: bytes per file.
Upload limit of a diff scan: bytes in total.
Sender of every e-mail. Required when EMAIL_HOST is set; no default in the Community Edition.
SMTP server. Unset: the instance sends no e-mail.
SMTP password.

true for implicit TLS (port 465), false for STARTTLS (default true).

Read only by the one-off script src/scripts/backfill-fingerprints.ts.
Public address of the web interface (CYBEDEFEND_PUBLIC_URL), used in links and redirects; the MCP server requires it in production.
Upload limit of a full scan: compressed archive bytes (default 5 GiB). What is kept for the scanner pods is also held to the 2 GiB they download.

Upload limit of a full scan: uncompressed bytes of any one entry (default 1 GiB).
Upload limit of a full scan: uncompressed bytes in total (default 5 GiB). What is kept for the scanner pods is also held to the 3 GiB they unpack.

Accepts the OAuth application secret as the token of a GitLab hook registered before each hook got its own token, until the token migration task has run (default false). A Community installation registers every hook with its own token.

Lets the scanner pods call their few methods without a service token, where a deployment routes them to the gRPC servers. The Community Edition never does: its scan pods report to the gateway over HTTP.
verify (log a call without a valid service token and serve it) or enforce (refuse it). The Community Edition always enforces and ignores the variable.
